name: ruled-polygon-sag
why: Three squares growing linearly (half-widths 10, 15, 20 at z = 0, 10, 20), lofted ruled through ThruSections. Their corners lie on straight lines, so the smooth loft OCCT builds through them is the same frustum: facet_sag_mm is 0 in closed form, and the volume is 20/3 (400 + 1600 + 800) = 18666.667 mm3. It holds the ThruSections half of the facet sag measurement, which compares the two solids' faces rather than surfaces the kernel computed itself.
